verdict.rationale: Raygun documents SDK-level filtering that removes sensitive data such as credit card details before errors are sent (raygun-docs-12, raygun-docs-24). Its only documented server-side control is a per-application 'Disable IP address storage' flag (raygun-docs-13), not general configurable scrubbing rules. Missing for 10: server-side configurable PII scrubbing rules beyond IP addresses, detail on SDK filter mechanics across languages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
